scenes.narration: Meet kinhin. Your Mac is your CI.

props.caption: Your jobs wait in line.
props.caption2: By default, one job at a time.

cues.text: A runner is the machine that runs your CI jobs.
By default, a self-hosted runner only runs one job at a time.

props.text: kinhin scales the fleet to your queue.

cues.text: It scales a fleet of runners to your queue, for every forge.

props.caption: A fresh VM for every job.
props.done: Deleted when the job is done.

scenes.narration: Each job gets a fresh VM or container, deleted when the job is done. Nothing carries over.

cues.text: This is the Fleet tab: jobs, VMs and the cap.
Each job runs in its own instance.
When one fails, the next job still gets a new one.

props.caption: Four forges. Three runtimes. One fleet.
props.note: Routed per repo, workflow or runs-on label.

soon.caption: Coming soon: Buildkite, Azure DevOps and Bitbucket.

cues.text: A forge is where your code and CI live.
kinhin works with GitHub, GitLab, Gitea and Forgejo.
Buildkite, Azure DevOps and Bitbucket are coming soon.

props.text: Two macOS jobs per Mac, Apple's limit.

scenes.narration: Apple allows two macOS virtual machines per Mac at a time, so two macOS jobs run at once.

props.label: config.yaml
props.caption: max_runners: VMs at once. runners_per_vm: jobs per VM.

scenes.narration: In one config file, max_runners is how many VMs run at once, and runners_per_vm is how many jobs share one VM.

props.text: Runs on Apple silicon, macOS 15 or later.
props.sub: Free and open source, Apache-2.0. No telemetry.

scenes.narration: Apple silicon, macOS 15 or later. Free, open source, and no telemetry.

props.text: Your repo can make its launch video too.

scenes.narration: Your repo can make its launch video too.

cues.text: One command builds it, in a container on your Mac.
The voice, the music and the checks are all included.

props.text: This video was built that way.

scenes.narration: This video was built exactly that way.

props.line: Your jobs stop waiting in line.

cues.text: Your jobs stop waiting in line.
kinhin.dev. Free, open source, in beta.
cues.say: kinhin dot dev. Free, open source, in beta.
